title: Mu Chen kills Mo Xingtian
summary: On the summit Mu Chen fights Mo Xingtian with the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods, while Xia Youran and Wen Busheng tie up Liu Ying and Dong Yuan with a Deadly Trapping Formation. Mo Xingtian boasts about crushing the divine soul of a North Heaven senior, and Mu Chen, fuelled by the academy's years of anger, burns Immortal Fire with his other flames as the watching students cheer him on. Though Mo Xingtian marvels that an early-phase Heavenly Completion fighter is this strong, Mu Chen sees through his Dragon-Transforming Blood Art and kills him despite the Black Dragon Sovereign's threats, then tells the other three to wait for the next baptism. The enraged Black Dragon Sovereign attacks and Tai Cang orders everyone to strike. Dong Ming, president of the Tianyuan Chamber, traps Mo You and Zhu Tian in a game of go, and Liu An of the Anying Chamber, a third-grade Sovereign, moves to hold Ling Xi. Tai Cang rings the Blood Soul Bell, and at the academy the Dragon Demon Palace's allies begin breaking the protective formation.

cultivation: Mo Xingtian says Mu Chen is only at the initial phase of Heavenly Completion. Liu An is a third-grade Sovereign; Ling Xi calls Lord Beiming (the Northern Sea Dragon) a ninth-grade Sovereign. The Black Dragon Sovereign's pressure is identified as a Sovereign's.
